mapper.insert: INSERT INTO u_a_point (id, o_sec_id, amount, `status`, expire_date, `removed`, create_time, creator, last_operate_time, last_operator) VALUES (NULL, #{oSecId},#{amount},#{status},#{expireDate}, 0,#{createTime},#{creator},#{lastOperateTime},#{lastOperator})
mapper.select: SELECT id, o_sec_id, amount, `status`, expire_date, `removed`, create_time, creator, last_operate_time, last_operator FROM u_a_point WHERE o_sec_id=#{oSecId} AND `status`="ACTIVE" AND `removed`=0
SELECT id, o_sec_id, amount, `status`, expire_date, `removed`, create_time, creator, last_operate_time, last_operator FROM u_a_point WHERE o_sec_id=#{oSecId} AND `removed`=0

SELECT id, o_sec_id, amount, `status`, expire_date, `removed`, create_time, creator, last_operate_time, last_operator FROM u_a_point WHERE DATE(expire_date) = DATE(DATE_ADD(#{currentTime}, INTERVAL 60 DAY)) AND `status`="ACTIVE"
mapper.update: UPDATE u_a_point SET `status`="EXPIRED" WHERE expire_date < #{currentTime} AND `status`="ACTIVE"
